name: STL_Tree_EraseIter_IntKey_N28_004d11d0
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frame_input_tick, read-only analysis. Supersedes STL_xlen_throw_004d11d0: this is not a length-error throw site but MSVC std::_Tree<...>::erase(iterator) for the 28h-node instantiation. __thiscall(this = tree, iterator* result, iterator by value {_Mycont, _Ptr}), RET 0Ch. The three arguments at the BSP_Game_OnMove call site 004e4fd2 are the hidden return-iterator pointer plus one checked iterator passed as two dwords, not three independent values. 004d11ec rejects a nil node and raises the MSVC debug message 'invalid map/set<T> iterator' (00ce44e0) through __CxxThrowException, which is what the old tag matched. It calls 004bf830 to compute the successor it returns and releases the erased node's value. The sibling 004d41a0 is the matching erase(first,last), whose whole-range fast path resets _Myhead->_Left/_Parent/_Right to _Myhead and _Mysize to 0 at 004d41f2..004d4204, fixing the container as {iterator list +0h, _Myhead +4h, _Mysize +8h}.

name: BSP_Game_EnqueueStateRequest
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = the ring buffer embedded at game+5D8h, one stack argument pointing at the 10h-byte element to copy, RET 4. Fields: +4 bucket array, +8 capacity, +0Ch head, +10h count; it grows through 004d20d0(1) when head+count is 4-aligned and the capacity is reached, allocates a 10h bucket on demand and copies the element in. BSP_Game_BeginStartupSequence uses it at 004e5796 to post state 10 after writing game+5D4h. Eleven callers, all game-state transitions including BSP_Game_OnMove. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.

name: BSP_Game_OnDestroy
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall f(game). The routine traces the literal GGame::OnDestroy(), so this is the game object teardown. It sets game+0x5d4 to 0x10, then calls 0046f3e0, 004da780 (scene termination, carrying PostScnTermModels/Shaders/Sounds/Textures and collectgarbage("collect")), 004da650, optionally DAT_00f8a2fc vtable+8 with 00992ac0, then 00b65e80 and 008844f0, deletes and nulls game+0x1a08, game+0x21a0, game+0x21d8, DAT_00e18678 and DAT_00e1867c, and ends with 004a9ac0. Callees below this level were not analyzed.

name: BSP_Game_OnInitOnce
evidence: Recovered scope label: the body references the literal GGame::OnInitOnce. __thiscall, ECX = the GGame object, one stack argument (a char first_time flag), RET 4. When first_time is zero it only re-runs OnInitTitle (004c9a70) plus 004dc200/008fafc0. When nonzero it opens the named profiling block, runs Scripts\fundamentals.lua via 00884be0, registers DoFile through 00b65e20 on the Lua state at ***(game+1A08h), stores 004c6880 at game+1A1Ch, runs Scripts\global\luaMW_init.lua through 00b69d40, sets the X360COMP Lua global via 008d44c0, initialises input slots 0/1/2 through 00a917e0, installs the GUI callbacks 00696590 and 006965a0, and when game+55Ch is zero loads Scripts\datatables\Inputs.lua through 00698a10. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.
